item.title: Town council approves floating bike lanes
item.description:
The council in Imaginaria voted 7–2 to trial floating cycle lanes on the canal.

Residents & boaters were consulted.

item.title: Local bakery invents a square doughnut
item.description: The bakery on Placeholder Lane says the new shape fits more neatly into boxes and leaves no room for the hole, which customers had long complained about.
